anchor: v1::Caleb Moreau, order ORD-20645. The locking clip on one of my trekking poles snapped on the trail. What are my options?

result.text: Sorry about the snapped clip, Caleb. Your Ridge trekking poles (order ORD-20645) were delivered on May 4, so they're past the 30-day return window, but they're still covered by our 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects. I've passed your claim to a human agent under ticket ESC-4103, and you should hear back within 1 business day. Please keep the pole and take photos of the broken clip for the review.

results.title: Warranty
results.body: All gear has a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects (for example a failed zipper, a delaminating sole or a device that will not power on). Warranty claims are reviewed by a human agent: escalate with category "warranty" and ask the customer to keep the item and any photos.

results.title: Opened electronics
results.body: Opened electronics (headphones, GPS units, headlamps, action cameras, watches) can be returned within 14 days of delivery. A 15% restocking fee is deducted from the refund. After 14 days, opened electronics are covered by warranty only.

results.title: Final sale
results.body: Items marked final sale (clearance) cannot be returned or exchanged. They are still covered by the warranty against manufacturing defects.

input.summary: Caleb Moreau (C-1017) reports the locking clip on one Ridge trekking pole snapped on the trail. Order was delivered 2026-05-04, outside the 30-day return window but within the 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Customer should keep the pole and any photos for review.
